profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 8+ years building TypeScript products end to end. Combines deep React expertise with Node.js backend development and hands-on agentic AI experience, with a record of shipping features that measurably improve conversion and performance. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality user interfaces in partnership with UX designers.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led critical frontend development initiatives driving company transformation and platform optimization. Partnered with AI/ML engineering teams to architect and deliver the user interface for an AI Agent builder platform, playing a key role in the company's strategic pivot to the AI market.

Engineered UI system for audio message delivery to remote appliances, featuring AI-powered text-to-speech capabilities and offline delivery mechanisms.

Technologies Utilized:
React, TypeScript, Jotai, Express.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Datadog. Implemented robust testing practices using Playwright and Cypress for end-to-end testing and quality assurance.

positions.title: UI Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Salesloft, I build and maintain the UI of analytics and reporting throughout the platform. We work primarily in React with a Ruby backend. During my time here, I took on a lead role for my team in the company-wide rebranding initiative.

Technologies Utilized:
JS, TypeScript, React, Ruby, Highcharts
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Programming · User Experience (UX) · Software Development · Communication · Git · Build Strong Relationships

positions.title: Senior User Interface Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the eCommerce platform for the three brands Carter’s owns: Carter’s, OshKosh B’Gosh, and Skip Hop. Utilized Salesforce Storefront Reference Architecture as the backend. Introduced the team to Vue.js as a solution for many areas of the website. Collaborated with UX, creative, marketing, and merchandising team members as part of a cross-functional e-commerce team.

Technologies Utilized:
JS, Vue, SCSS, Python, Salesforce Commerce Cloud
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Programming · User Experience (UX) · Software Development · Communication · Git · Build Strong Relationships

positions.title: Associate Director Of Development
positions.description:
As the Associate Director of Development, I led a team of developers to produce highly engaging web experiences. I also spearheaded the execution of email marketing campaigns using various marketing automation tools and CRM platforms.

Technologies Utilized:
JavaScript, React, Vue, SCSS, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, Jigsaw, Photoshop
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Software Development · Communication · Git · Build Strong Relationships

positions.title: Marketing Technologist
positions.description:
Worked with and oversaw cross-functional teams (marketing, creative services, and sales) and global teams (Latin America, EMEA, and APAC countries). Key player in streamlining existing processes, developing and executing time-sensitive projects, and strategizing new lead flow processes for the department.

Key contributor to the migration of IBM’s $400M acquisition of Silverpop into IBM's Watson Customer Engagement portfolio of product marketing offerings. The project involved managing 10+ contributors and consolidating two external websites into one product hub hosted within IBM.com.

Utilized KPIs, trends, and market research to develop a content roadmap for the new website, new landing pages, and potential campaigns.

Integrated Git as the system to manage the main IBM Marketing Cloud website, landing pages, and global IBM Marketing Cloud websites for the team.

Co-authored a lead flow diagram for the IBM Watson Marketing executive team to consider for IBM's Think Marketing Hub initiative.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Communication · Git · Build Strong Relationships

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Developed highly engaging web experiences. Led the execution of email marketing campaigns utilizing various marketing automation tools (Marketo, Silverpop, Pardot, and Fishbowl) and CRM platforms (Salesforce). Interacted with clients to provide training, support, and analysis of site performance. Contributed to the creation of various advertising campaigns and digital strategies for multiple clients.

Technologies Utilized:
HTML, JavaScript, SCSS, Node, PHP, Marketo, Silverpop, Salesforce, Photoshop
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · User Experience (UX) · Communication · Git · Build Strong Relationships
